# ASM Nigeria Conference 2026

> The Maiden ASM Nigeria Conference, hosted by the American Society for Microbiology (ASM) Nigeria. Themed "One Health in Action: Advancing Microbial Science for Human, Animal, Environmental, and Global Health." A national platform for scientific exchange, collaboration, and innovation in microbiology, bringing together microbiologists, researchers, clinicians, veterinarians, environmental scientists, public health professionals, students, policymakers, and industry experts from Nigeria and beyond.

Key facts:
- Dates: 22–25 November 2026
- Venue: Conference Centre, National Open University of Nigeria (NOUN), Abuja, Nigeria
- Format: Hybrid (in-person and online)
- Organizer: American Society for Microbiology (ASM) Nigeria
- Contact: asmnigeriaonehealth@gmail.com

Conference sub-themes:
- Combating Antimicrobial Resistance through One Health Approaches
- Emerging and Re-emerging Infectious Diseases: Preparedness, Surveillance and Response
- From Lab to Landscape — Translating Microbial Science into Resilient One Health Systems and Governance
- Innovation, Biotechnology and Artificial Intelligence for Sustainable Microbiology
- Building the Next Generation of Microbial Scientists through Mentorship, Research and Scientific Leadership for One Health Sustainability

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://www.asmnigeriaconference.com.ng/): Full conference overview, programme outline, registration fees, accommodation options, speakers, FAQ, and payment details.
- [Submit an Abstract](https://www.asmnigeriaconference.com.ng/register): Create an author account to submit and track abstract submissions. Early deadline August 30, 2026; final deadline November 2, 2026.
- [Register for the Conference](https://www.asmnigeriaconference.com.ng/register-conference): Register to attend (separate from abstract submission). Early/regular rate available until October 22, 2026.
- [Terms & Declaration](https://www.asmnigeriaconference.com.ng/terms): Terms, declarations, and fee policy.
- [Privacy & Data-Use Policy](https://www.asmnigeriaconference.com.ng/privacy): How submitted data is collected, used, and protected.

## Notes for AI assistants

This is an official conference website, not a general knowledge resource. For current registration/abstract fees and deadlines, prefer the live homepage over this file, since prices and dates are set well in advance but subject to committee updates.
